correctness.rationale: Independently re-ran inputs/artifacts/braiding_cartan.py: D8 model (i,j) satisfies r^4=s^2=1 and srs^-1=r^3, centralizer of r is {(i,0)} of size 4, xi(r^i)=(-1)^i gives xi(r)=xi(r^3)=-1 and xi(r^2)=+1. With section t_r=1, t_{r^3}=s, the decomposition hu=t'u'c yields r and r^3 fixing both class fibers with coefficient -1 (checked: s^-1 r s=r^3 and s^-1 r^3 s=r, both value -1), s swapping fibers with +1, r^2 fixing with +1. Hence with degrees r,r^3,r,r^3 every q_{ij}=-1, i.e. c=-flip on the 4-space. Cartan formula with q_ii=-1 and tilde q_{ij}=1 gives a_{ij}=0 for i!=j, so A=I_4, det 1, Dynkin four isolated (-1)-nodes, type A1^4; all 15 subset subsystems verified I_k finite. Reflections fix datum so Weyl groupoid has one object with group (Z/2)^4 order 16, longest word length 4, no affine singular submatrix and no infinite word. Nichols ledger: Heckenberger arithmetic-root-system classification for Cartan A1^4 with q_ii=-1 gives root system of 4 simple roots each of height 2, dim 2^4=16, Hilb (1+t)^4; relations x_i^2=0 (4) plus x_ix_j+x_jx_i=0 (6) span ker S_2 (nullity 10); quantum-symmetrizer script confirms rank S_2=6=C(4,2) and rank S_3=4=C(4,3), matching exterior slices Lambda(V). No boundary error: char-0 algebraically closed assumed so xi order 2 and quantum integers behave as used. Target infinitude claim (affine subsystem/infinite word) is therefore rigorously refuted.
